resources.string: Choose the language of the app. System default follows your phone.
On: a weapon earns more XP, headgear more gold and armour takes less damage. Off: gear is only for show and every score is the base number. Your look never changes with this switch.
On: finished tasks hurt your boss, and it escapes if you run out of days. Off: bosses take no damage and the clock stops. A running quest is kept and waits for you.
On: from level 10 you can pick a class, spend stat points and cast skills with mana. Off: no class bonuses, no skills and no mana bar. Your choices are kept.
Anything you do before this hour counts for the previous day, and dailies are scored when the new day begins. Changing it never causes damage.
Missed dailies deal no damage and streaks stay frozen. Turn it on for holidays or illness. A break of more than two days is treated as paused automatically.
Notifications are off, so reminders cannot appear.
Reminders arrive at the exact time.
Exact alarms are off, so reminders may arrive a few minutes late.
No tags yet. Add them when you edit a task.
Deleting a tag only removes the label. Your tasks stay.
Everything lives on this phone. Save a backup file to keep it safe or to move to another phone.
Erase all tasks, rewards, history, tags, reminders and your character from this phone. Save a backup first if you may want it back.

Some phone makers stop background apps to save battery, which can delay reminders and the daily check. If that happens, exclude this app from battery optimisation. The game also catches up every time you open the app, so nothing is lost.
A private, offline habit RPG. Track habits, dailies and to-dos, earn XP and gold, and keep your hero healthy. All data stays on your device.
This replaces everything in the app right now: tasks, history, rewards and settings. This cannot be undone.
This permanently erases your tasks, rewards, history, character and settings, and the app starts over. This cannot be undone.
